status_summary: Treasury announced on 2025-03-02 that it would not enforce the Act against U.S. citizens and domestic companies, and FinCEN's interim final rule of 2025-03-21 (published 2025-03-26) exempted domestic reporting companies and U.S. persons. A final rule announced by Treasury on 2026-08-11 and effective 2026-08-14 makes those exemptions permanent and provides for deletion of previously reported U.S.-person data; foreign reporting companies must still report their foreign beneficial owners. The statute has not been repealed. H.R. 425, which would limit beneficial ownership reporting to foreign-owned companies rather than repeal the Act outright, was advanced by the House Financial Services Committee 26 to 25 on 2026-04-21, and no floor vote was found.

timeline.event: Treasury announced it would not enforce Corporate Transparency Act reporting requirements against U.S. citizens or domestic reporting companies (an enforcement position that did not itself change the rule).

FinCEN issued an interim final rule exempting domestic companies and U.S. persons from beneficial ownership reporting; only foreign entities registered to do business in a U.S. jurisdiction remained covered (published in the Federal Register 2025-03-26).
House Financial Services Committee voted 26 to 25 to advance H.R. 425, the Repealing Big Brother Overreach Act, which would repeal the Act's reporting for domestic companies.

Senators Lee and Kennedy cosponsor S. 4419, which would enact the narrowed interim rule into law and require deletion of previously collected personal beneficial ownership information (per Mondaq, published 2026-06-24).

Treasury announced a final rule that permanently removes beneficial ownership reporting for U.S. companies and U.S. persons, effective 2026-08-14; foreign reporting companies still report non-U.S. beneficial owners.
Final rule published in the Federal Register and effective on publication, with a one-time deletion of U.S.-person data from the reporting system.
FinCEN's final rule is published at 91 FR 52508 (document 2026-16576) and takes effect the same day.
